district.name: Udupi
district.geographic_features: Flanked by Western Ghats and Arabian Sea, noted for its unique basalt rock islands and coastal backwaters.
district.climate: Tropical maritime climate with heavy monsoon showers.
district.image_alt: Malpe Beach on the Udupi coastline

records.title: Sri Krishna Matha & Ashta Mathas
records.description: Founded by the 13th-century philosopher Sri Madhvacharya, famous for the Kanakana Kindi and the vibrant Paryaya festival.

records.title: St. Mary's Island Basaltic Formations
records.description: Unique geological monument featuring columnar basaltic lava formations created during Madagascar-India split 88 million years ago.

records.title: Udupi Vegetarian Culinary Tradition
records.description: Renowned worldwide for healthy, plant-based sattvic cuisine rooted in temple traditions, utilizing local gourds, pulses, and jackfruit.

places.name: St. Mary's Islands
places.description: A group of four small islands off Malpe coast featuring spectacular hexagonal basaltic rock pillars and shell beaches.

places.name: Sri Krishna Matha
places.description: World-renowned Vaishnavite monastery and temple complex established by Sri Madhvacharya.

places.name: Malpe Beach & Sea Walk
places.description: A bustling natural fishing harbor and pristine beach featuring a scenic 450-meter sea walk into the Arabian Sea.

media_references.subject: Geological heritage
